why: failed AI calls cost nothing, history lists charges and refunds, shown in Settings in both languages, tests and changelog
prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: The Settings page now shows the credit history under the credit balance, in English and Korean. Each row has the date and time in the user's locale, a label for what the credits were for (unknown actions show as "Other"), and the amount, with additions in green and a "+" sign. Refunds read "Refund: <action>" and carry a green "Refund" badge. The list reloads when the balance changes. The frontend type-check is clean, the new component has no lint problems, the two message files have the same keys, and the 21 backend tests pass. I haven't seen it in a browser. I also changed the history endpoint to mark `created_at` as UTC so local times display correctly.

+"""GET /workspaces/{id}/credits/history lists a workspace's credit changes."""
+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+
+API = "/api/v1"
+
+
+def workspace_id(client, h):
+    return client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["id"]
+
+
+def history(client, h, ws_id):
+    return client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{ws_id}/credits/history", headers=h)
+
+
+def new_project(client, h):
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def test_new_workspace_has_empty_history(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    r = history(client, h, workspace_id(client, h))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json() == []
+
+
+def test_history_lists_charges_refunds_and_refills_newest_first(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws_id = workspace_id(client, h)
+    pid = new_project(client, h)
+
+    # A successful charge.
+    assert client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    # A failed one: charged, then refunded.
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    assert client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    # Daily refill (granted when the workspace is opened).
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{ws_id}", headers=h).status_code == 200
+
+    r = history(client, h, ws_id)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    items = r.json()
+    assert [(i["amount"], i["action"]) for i in items] == [
+        (50, "daily_refill"),
+        (15, "refund:generate_project_cover_image"),
+        (-15, "generate_project_cover_image"),
+        (-15, "generate_project_cover_image"),
+    ]
+    for i in items:
+        assert set(i) == {"amount", "action", "created_at"}
+    times = [datetime.fromisoformat(i["created_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00")) for i in items]
+    assert all(t.utcoffset() is not None and t.utcoffset().total_seconds() == 0 for t in times)
+    assert times == sorted(times, reverse=True)
+    # The history adds up to the balance.
+    balance = client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+    assert 500 + sum(i["amount"] for i in items) == balance == 535
+
+
+def test_history_only_shows_this_workspace(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    other = signup(client, email="other@example.com")
+    pid = new_project(client, other)
+    assert client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=other).status_code == 200
+
+    assert history(client, h, workspace_id(client, h)).json() == []
+    assert len(history(client, other, workspace_id(client, other)).json()) == 1
+
+
+def test_non_member_gets_404_like_a_missing_workspace(client):
+    owner = signup(client)
+    stranger = signup(client, email="stranger@example.com")
+    ws_id = workspace_id(client, owner)
+
+    r = history(client, stranger, ws_id)
+    missing = history(client, stranger, str(uuid.uuid4()))
+    assert r.status_code == 404, r.text
+    assert missing.status_code == 404
+    assert r.json() == missing.json()
+    assert r.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_WORKSPACE"
